title: Why fewer options lead to quicker decisions
hook: Too many choices can actually make it harder to decide.

narration.text: Too many choices can actually make it harder to decide.
This is called the paradox of choice.
When we have fewer options, our brains process them more easily.
Each additional choice demands more mental effort and comparison.
More choices also increase the fear of making the wrong decision.
This can lead to decision paralysis, where we choose nothing at all.
So, next time you are overwhelmed, try narrowing your options.
Have you noticed this effect when shopping or planning something?

description: Ever feel stuck when presented with endless options? It's not just you. This video explains the 'paradox of choice' and why having fewer decisions often leads to quicker, more confident decisions, not less satisfaction.
topic: Why you often make quicker decisions when you have fewer options, explaining paradox of choice.
